title: Every action leaves a receipt.
slide_intent: Make an automated action inspectable so the person who delegated it can account for the amount, fee and signer.
strategic_value: Specific amounts, a signature description and the depleted allowance make the accountability promise legible.
demonstration: A sample ticket records a $40.00 Jupiter purchase of 0.2318 SOL and ties it back to the Weekly SOL buy key. One ticket illustrates the record format.
practical_value: Use this panel as a reference for turning a broad accountability claim into a readable transaction record.

content_islands.name: Headline field
content_islands.spec: On white, break the black headline after “action” and follow it with “What it did, which key it used, what it cost.”

content_islands.name: Ticket opening
content_islands.spec: Place a centered black-rimmed phone at the same height as the other panels. Inside the pale Ticket screen, start a rounded white ticket with “Ticket No 0418” and the purchase summary in large black type.

content_islands.name: Receipt details
content_islands.spec: Arrange six divided label/value rows for Key, Paid, Received, Fee, When and Signed. Show Weekly SOL buy, $40.00, 0.2318 SOL, $0.16, Fri 7 Nov, 09:00 and “Agent, inside the key” respectively.

content_islands.name: Allowance and sharing
content_islands.spec: Separate the receipt stub with a dotted perforation. Pair the spent dot field with “$0 of $40 left this week”. Place a full-width black “Share receipt” control beneath the ticket.
